name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Orders and kitchen for a food truck
promotionalText: Receive orders in advance, protect your kitchen from being overwhelmed by orders, and keep serving even if the network cuts out. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks (food vehicles): the tool your team uses to run service.

Customers order ahead and choose a time to collect the order. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook, then mark it “Ready” and “Collected”.

DON’T PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T MEET
Set how much your kitchen can cook at one time and how much time it needs. When a collection time fills up, customers can’t choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen’s capacity.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE FOOD TRUCK
Add on-the-spot orders on the same screen as the advance orders, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen (KDS) shows what to cook now, what’s next and what’s ready, and alerts you when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a kitchen receipt printer via Bluetooth or your local network, and order tickets will print automatically.

KEEP SERVING EVEN IF THE NETWORK CUTS OUT
Switch on offline protection, and if the connection cuts out, advance orders are paused for a while so nobody places an order you won’t see. Orders you take on the device are saved and synced when you are back online.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and the places you sell once, then take orders for each event.

HatchGrab is for food truck owners and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
